title: Griglia di subplot
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3)
print(axs.shape, len(fig.axes))
codeHtml: import matplotlib.pyplot as plt fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3) print(axs.shape, len(fig.axes))
explain: subplots(2, 3) restituisce un array di assi 2×3: sei assi in tutto.
